originParagraphs: The Timber Bros Podcast kicked off when Plummo and Hazy — both active creators in Australia's woodworking world — realised the conversations happening in the comments section, at markets, and between mates deserved a proper home.

Together they represent Plummo's Timber and Hazys Wood — two well-known names in the Aussie woodworking scene on social media — bringing those same communities into a long-form, no-frills podcast format.
The show is recorded at Oz Soundz Studios in Sydney NSW, and releases monthly on all major podcast platforms.
While currently audio-only, the lads are heading to video — with full visual episodes, workshop tours, and behind-the-scenes content in the pipeline. Watch this space.
quote: "We just wanted a yarn. Turns out a lot of people wanted to listen in."

studio.title: Recorded at Oz Soundz Studios
studio.text: Sydney NSW — professional audio production giving The Timber Bros the sound quality their content deserves.

whyCards.title: The Craft
whyCards.text: Deep dives into timber species, resin techniques, finishing secrets, and the slow art of doing things right — even when it takes a little longer.

whyCards.title: The Tools
whyCards.text: Honest reviews, head-to-head comparisons, and no-BS advice on the gear that's worth your hard-earned. From chainsaws to chisels.

whyCards.title: The Business
whyCards.text: The reality of running a timber business or workshop in the modern world — marketing, social media, pricing, and the stories behind the sawdust.

whyCards.title: The Community
whyCards.text: Interviews with artisans, designers, sawmillers, and people who love working with their hands. People who've earned their calluses.

whyCards.title: Men's Health
whyCards.text: Important conversations about mental health, physical wellbeing, and the unique pressures men in trades face — spoken plainly, without the fluff.

whyCards.title: Women's Health & Women in Timber
whyCards.text: Celebrating and supporting the women in our industry. Health conversations that matter, and shining a light on female makers doing amazing work.
